description:
Cafes, restaurants, takeaway, bakeries, pubs and bars, bottle shops and breweries or wineries: counts in the suburb, rates per 1,000 residents and distance from the suburb centre to the nearest of each.

Coverage: All Australian suburbs and localities. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/food-and-drink`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: count_takeaway, per_1000_takeaway, nearest_km_takeaway, count_cafes, per_1000_cafes, nearest_km_cafes, count_restaurants, per_1000_restaurants, nearest_km_restaurants, count_bakeries, per_1000_bakeries, nearest_km_bakeries, count_pubs_bars, per_1000_pubs_bars, nearest_km_pubs_bars, count_bottle_shops, per_1000_bottle_shops, nearest_km_bottle_shops, count_breweries_wineries, per_1000_breweries_wineries, nearest_km_breweries_wineries, count_total, per_1000_total, per_km2_total. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_amenities_food_and_drink
title: Suburb · Food and drink places
